title: Exodus Bible Quiz - Chapter 19
description: Ten questions on Exodus 19: Israel at Mount Sinai, God's covenant offer and the people preparing to meet him.

questions.text: In which month after leaving Egypt did Israel come into the wilderness of Sinai?
questions.explanation: In the third month after the children of Israel had gone out of Egypt, they came into the wilderness of Sinai.

questions.text: On what did Yahweh say he had carried Israel and brought them to himself?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said: 'You have seen ... how I bore you on eagles' wings, and brought you to myself.'

answers.text: In the palm of his hand

questions.text: If Israel kept God's covenant, what would they be to him?
questions.explanation: Israel would be God's own possession from among all peoples, a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.

answers.text: A mighty army among the nations
A people ruled by many kings
A kingdom of priests and a holy nation

questions.text: How did all the people answer when Moses set Yahweh's words before them?
questions.explanation: All the people answered together: 'All that Yahweh has spoken we will do.'

answers.text: All that Yahweh has spoken we will do
Give us time to think about it
Give us a king like the nations
Let us go back to Egypt

questions.text: In what did Yahweh say he would come to Moses, so the people could hear him speak?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said: 'Behold, I come to you in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with you.'

questions.text: What were the people to do while they were being sanctified?
questions.explanation: Moses was to sanctify the people today and tomorrow, and let them wash their garments.

questions.text: What would happen to anyone who touched the mountain?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said: 'Whoever touches the mountain shall be surely put to death.'

answers.text: He would be unclean until evening
He would surely be put to death
He would have to wash his clothes
He would have to bring an offering

questions.text: Where did the people stand when Moses led them out of the camp to meet God?
questions.explanation: Moses led the people out of the camp to meet God, and they stood at the lower part of the mountain.

answers.text: On the top of the mountain
On the far side of a river
At the lower part of the mountain

questions.text: Why did all of Mount Sinai smoke?
questions.explanation: All of Mount Sinai smoked because Yahweh descended on it in fire, and the whole mountain quaked greatly.

answers.text: Because lightning set the trees on fire
Because Yahweh descended on it in fire
Because Moses lit a fire on top

questions.text: Whom did Yahweh tell Moses to bring up with him?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said: 'You shall bring Aaron up with you,' but the priests and the people were not to break through.
